### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

## Health Systems Worldwide

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

* [Fusion][18]

* ## Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  
  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the
  world's biggest technology companies use OCI.
  
  **OCI Tech Customers**
  
  AMD, ByteDance, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Temu, TikTok, Uber, xAI
  
  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In
  response to this shortage, Oracle is building AI cloud capacity as quickly as we can.
  
  [Learn more][22]
  [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure]
  
  ### Building the World's Largest AI Cloud
  
  1.2 billion watt Texas data center | 500,000 NVIDIA GPUs
* [MultiCloud Database]
  
  ### Oracle AI Database in 200+ Data Centers
  
  Multicloud: 22@AWS, 15@Google, 33@Azure and 135@Oracle Cloud
  
  ## Multicloud AI Database
  
  Oracle AI Database in every cloud
  
  Amazon · Google · Microsoft · Oracle
  
  **Most Advanced Database Technology**
  
  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is
  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.
  
  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .
  
  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**
  
  [Human Resources][30]
  [Payroll][31]
  
  **Customer Experience**
  
  [Marketing][32]
  [Sales][33]
  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]
  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion
  
  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation
* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]
* ## Industry Specific Applications
  
  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.
  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**
  
  Includes merchandising, multistore inventory management, omnichannel demand forecasting, etc.
  
  [Learn More][37]

  NetSuite pioneered a new generation of SaaS applications and cloud technology.
  * **43,000+ customers in 200+ countries and dependent territories**
  * **77% of the Forbes Cloud 100 companies are NetSuite customers**
  * **61% of technology IPOs since 2011 are NetSuite customers**

  **Finance and Accounting**
  General Ledger, AP/AR, tax management,  and more
  
  **Global**
  Consolidation, Multicurrency, Multilanguage
  
  **CRM**

  **Planning and Budgeting**

visual analytics, then share insights securely–without any need to manage servers or infrastructure.

A self-hosted analytics platform, to gain full control of your data and analytics deployment,
whether implementing on your own infrastructure or in the cloud (private and public instances).

An open analytics platform that combines AI, trusted data, modular architecture, and direct workflow
integration, to turn insights into actions faster and smarter than ever.

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended

technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

#### Science & Innovation

We enable breakthrough science and technology within our businesses by looking beyond current
products and platforms to create the technologies and applications that will become the foundation
of tomorrow’s successes.

[Learn about our science][73]

From our environment to our associates, we’re determined to create positive impact that accelerates
greater progress.

[Read the 2026 Sustainability Report][74]

## Preguntas
## frecuentes

Estas son algunas de las preguntas que se hacen nuestros usuarios

### ¿Qué es Empresite?

Empresite es un directorio de empresas creado en 2010 por INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) con el fin de
ayudar a los empresarios a encontrar nuevos clientes, mediante la publicación gratuita de los
productos y servicios que ofrecen.

### ¿Qué beneficios puede obtener mi empresa al aparecer en Empresite?

El objeto de Empresite es favorecer y fomentar las relaciones entre empresas, así como facilitar la
búsqueda de nuevos clientes, mediante el desarrollo de una plataforma única en España con
información actualizada de más de 3 millones de empresas. Por ello, Empresite se puede considerar
como un excelente medio de comunicación gratuito para empresas y autónomos.

### ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

La información de Empresite puede provenir de dos fuentes:
1. Información que publica un usuario registrado y que afirma previamente tener relación directa con
   la empresa.
2. Información procedente de la Base de Datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME), que se nutre de múltiples
   fuentes de información, públicas y privadas como el BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro
   Mercantil), Depósitos de Cuentas Oficiales, BOE (Boletín Oficial del Estado), Boletines Oficiales
   Provinciales y de CC.AA., Prensa nacional y regional, Investigaciones ad hoc y Publicaciones
   Diversas.


Sea cual fuere el origen de la información disponible en el directorio de Empresite, todo contenido
publicado en la Web de Empresite está sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de
Condiciones de uso y Política de privacidad.

### ¿Cómo puedo buscar una empresa en concreto?

Existen varias vías para realizar una búsqueda de una empresa:
1. Rellenando los campos del buscador de la parte superior de la Home de Empresite.
2. Mediante la búsqueda alfabética de empresas o de categorías situada en la parte inferior de la
   Home de Empresite.

### ¿Cómo puedo añadir una empresa?

Añadir una empresa en el directorio de Empresite es un proceso muy sencillo para el que únicamente
se requiere estar registrado como usuario y estar relacionado de manera directa con la empresa a
publicar. Puedes encontrar tu empresa navegando por Empresite, o bien a través del enlace en la
cabecera "Publica tu empresa" donde únicamente necesitarás indicar el CIF. Pincha [aquí][147] y
publica ahora tu empresa.

### ¿Se mantiene algún histórico después de borrar los datos de Empresite?

Tanto el registro en Empresite como el uso y disfrute del servicio, son gratuitos. El usuario
únicamente se verá sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad.

### ¿Por qué no puedo modificar una empresa?

Puede haber varios motivos por el que el sistema no permita modificar una empresa del directorio de
Empresite, los más comunes pueden ser:
1. Que otro usuario tenga registrada la misma empresa.
2. Que el sistema detecte que el usuario no pertenece a esa empresa o no tiene relación directa con
   ella.
3. Que un usuario haya reportado un abuso sobre la empresa y la información de la empresa esté
   siendo investigada.

### ¿Cómo han aparecido los datos de mi empresa en Empresite?

Como se especifica en el apartado anterior, la información publicada en Empresite puede proceder de
los usuarios del directorio o de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME). Más información sobre
las fuentes de Empresite en [¿De dónde viene la información de Empresite?][148]

### Los datos de mi empresa no son correctos o son falsos, ¿qué puedo hacer?

Cualquier usuario que advierta información incorrecta o falsa sobre su empresa, tendrá el deber de
informar al Equipo de Empresite, tal y como se especifica en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad, mediante la opción “Repotar abuso” que está disponible en cada ficha de
empresa. Tras ello, se recibirá respuesta por parte del Equipo de Empresite en un plazo máximo de 2
días hábiles. ¿Los datos de tu empresa no son correctos? Reporta un abuso ahora.

### ¿Alguien puede modificar los datos de mi empresa?

Es requisito por parte de Empresite que únicamente las personas que tengan relación directa con una
empresa puedan publicar datos de ésta.

### No recuerdo mi contraseña, ¿cómo puedo recuperarla?

Se puede recuperar la contraseña rápidamente desde la zona de Acceso usuarios, pinchando en Recordar
contraseña. Automáticamente el Equipo de Empresite enviará las claves a la dirección de correo del
registro.

### ¿Cómo puedo modificar mis datos de usuario?

Los datos de usuario se pueden modificar desde la Zona de Usuarios en a sección de Mi cuenta/ Datos
de usuario. Si quieres modificar tus datos de usuario pincha [aquí][149].

### ¿Cómo borrar mi empresa del directorio de Empresite?

Si has registrado una empresa, puedes borrar la información que has cedido a Empresite mediante el
formulario “reportar abuso”. Tras ello, el Equipo de Empresite eliminará los datos proporcionados
por el usuario. En cualquier caso, los datos provenientes de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A.
(SME) se mantendrán publicados en el Directorio de Empresite. Más información sobre las fuentes del
Directorio de Empresite en ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

### ¿A disposición de quien está la información que aporto de mi empresa?

Usted accede a poner el contenido a disposición de otras compañías, organizaciones o personas
físicas que accedan a consultar información de su empresa a través de este sitio en Internet
(empresite) o cualquier otro que la empresa INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) disponga, o como parte de
servicios o productos en cualquier jurisdicción en la que opere INFORMA.

## Preguntas
## frecuentes

Estas son algunas de las preguntas que se hacen nuestros usuarios

### ¿Qué es Empresite?

Empresite es un directorio de empresas creado en 2010 por INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) con el fin de
ayudar a los empresarios a encontrar nuevos clientes, mediante la publicación gratuita de los
productos y servicios que ofrecen.

### ¿Qué beneficios puede obtener mi empresa al aparecer en Empresite?

El objeto de Empresite es favorecer y fomentar las relaciones entre empresas, así como facilitar la
búsqueda de nuevos clientes, mediante el desarrollo de una plataforma única en España con
información actualizada de más de 3 millones de empresas. Por ello, Empresite se puede considerar
como un excelente medio de comunicación gratuito para empresas y autónomos.

### ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

La información de Empresite puede provenir de dos fuentes:
1. Información que publica un usuario registrado y que afirma previamente tener relación directa con
   la empresa.
2. Información procedente de la Base de Datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME), que se nutre de múltiples
   fuentes de información, públicas y privadas como el BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro
   Mercantil), Depósitos de Cuentas Oficiales, BOE (Boletín Oficial del Estado), Boletines Oficiales
   Provinciales y de CC.AA., Prensa nacional y regional, Investigaciones ad hoc y Publicaciones
   Diversas.


Sea cual fuere el origen de la información disponible en el directorio de Empresite, todo contenido
publicado en la Web de Empresite está sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de
Condiciones de uso y Política de privacidad.

### ¿Cómo puedo buscar una empresa en concreto?

Existen varias vías para realizar una búsqueda de una empresa:
1. Rellenando los campos del buscador de la parte superior de la Home de Empresite.
2. Mediante la búsqueda alfabética de empresas o de categorías situada en la parte inferior de la
   Home de Empresite.

### ¿Cómo puedo añadir una empresa?

Añadir una empresa en el directorio de Empresite es un proceso muy sencillo para el que únicamente
se requiere estar registrado como usuario y estar relacionado de manera directa con la empresa a
publicar. Puedes encontrar tu empresa navegando por Empresite, o bien a través del enlace en la
cabecera "Publica tu empresa" donde únicamente necesitarás indicar el CIF. Pincha [aquí][147] y
publica ahora tu empresa.

### ¿Se mantiene algún histórico después de borrar los datos de Empresite?

Tanto el registro en Empresite como el uso y disfrute del servicio, son gratuitos. El usuario
únicamente se verá sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad.

### ¿Por qué no puedo modificar una empresa?

Puede haber varios motivos por el que el sistema no permita modificar una empresa del directorio de
Empresite, los más comunes pueden ser:
1. Que otro usuario tenga registrada la misma empresa.
2. Que el sistema detecte que el usuario no pertenece a esa empresa o no tiene relación directa con
   ella.
3. Que un usuario haya reportado un abuso sobre la empresa y la información de la empresa esté
   siendo investigada.

### ¿Cómo han aparecido los datos de mi empresa en Empresite?

Como se especifica en el apartado anterior, la información publicada en Empresite puede proceder de
los usuarios del directorio o de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME). Más información sobre
las fuentes de Empresite en [¿De dónde viene la información de Empresite?][148]

### Los datos de mi empresa no son correctos o son falsos, ¿qué puedo hacer?

Cualquier usuario que advierta información incorrecta o falsa sobre su empresa, tendrá el deber de
informar al Equipo de Empresite, tal y como se especifica en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad, mediante la opción “Repotar abuso” que está disponible en cada ficha de
empresa. Tras ello, se recibirá respuesta por parte del Equipo de Empresite en un plazo máximo de 2
días hábiles. ¿Los datos de tu empresa no son correctos? Reporta un abuso ahora.

### ¿Alguien puede modificar los datos de mi empresa?

Es requisito por parte de Empresite que únicamente las personas que tengan relación directa con una
empresa puedan publicar datos de ésta.

### No recuerdo mi contraseña, ¿cómo puedo recuperarla?

Se puede recuperar la contraseña rápidamente desde la zona de Acceso usuarios, pinchando en Recordar
contraseña. Automáticamente el Equipo de Empresite enviará las claves a la dirección de correo del
registro.

### ¿Cómo puedo modificar mis datos de usuario?

Los datos de usuario se pueden modificar desde la Zona de Usuarios en a sección de Mi cuenta/ Datos
de usuario. Si quieres modificar tus datos de usuario pincha [aquí][149].

### ¿Cómo borrar mi empresa del directorio de Empresite?

Si has registrado una empresa, puedes borrar la información que has cedido a Empresite mediante el
formulario “reportar abuso”. Tras ello, el Equipo de Empresite eliminará los datos proporcionados
por el usuario. En cualquier caso, los datos provenientes de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A.
(SME) se mantendrán publicados en el Directorio de Empresite. Más información sobre las fuentes del
Directorio de Empresite en ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

### ¿A disposición de quien está la información que aporto de mi empresa?

Usted accede a poner el contenido a disposición de otras compañías, organizaciones o personas
físicas que accedan a consultar información de su empresa a través de este sitio en Internet
(empresite) o cualquier otro que la empresa INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) disponga, o como parte de
servicios o productos en cualquier jurisdicción en la que opere INFORMA.

## Our company

### Global leader in amplification, detection and imaging technologies

Exosens is a high-tech company, with more than 85 years of experience in the innovation,
development, manufacturing and sale of high-end electro-optical technologies in the field of
amplification, detection and imaging. Today, it offers its customers detection components and
solutions such as advanced cameras, neutron and gamma detectors, instrument detectors and light
intensifier tubes. This allows Exosens to respond to complex issues in extremely demanding
environments by offering tailor-made solutions to its customers. Thanks to its sustained
investments, Exosens is internationally recognized as a major innovator in optoelectronics, with
production and R&D carried out on 12 sites, in Europe and North America, and with over 2,000
employees.

Exosens is listed on compartment A of Euronext Paris regulated market (Ticker: EXENS; ISIN:
FR001400Q9V2). Exosens is a member of Euronext Tech Leaders segment and is also included in several
indices, including SBF 120, CAC All-Tradable, CAC Mid 60, FTSE Total Cap and MSCI France Small Cap.

amplification, detection and imaging. Today, it offers its customers detection components and

# What is Infocepts?

Infocepts is a global data and AI consulting firm that helps large enterprises in retail and CPG,
media and entertainment, life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, and financial services
build governed, AI-ready data infrastructure and turn it into measurable commercial outcomes.

We deliver across the full data and AI stack – from data strategy and architecture through data
engineering, business analytics, AI platform development, and managed operations – with 500+ data
and AI engineers operating from delivery centers in the US, UK, India, and Australia.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Washington, D.C., Infocepts is rated #1 on Gartner Peer
Insights in our category, holds a 97.2% client retention rate, and has been recognized as
MicroStrategy’s North America Partner of the Year 2025 and a Databricks Silver Partner.

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

### This is a node. Nodes perform discrete actions on data.

Like access, read, transform, merge, split, learn, predict, write, visualize.

### Connect nodes together to create a workflow.

Workflows depict sequential steps performed on data from left to right.

### You decide when to run your workflow.

Run the workflow node by node, in segments, or all at once. Re-run any time.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like clean and filter.

For example, looking at customer data from a specific region.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform a simple analysis.

For example, comparing budget vs. actual spend.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform an advanced analysis.

For example, using a decision tree for understanding churn.

### …and more.

e.g. geospatial analysis, image analysis, deep learning, generative AI, and much more.

Start with any data science experience and level up over time.

Run the workflow node by node, in segments, or all at once. Re-run any time.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like clean and filter.

For example, looking at customer data from a specific region.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform a simple analysis.

For example, comparing budget vs. actual spend.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform an advanced analysis.

For example, using a decision tree for understanding churn.

e.g. geospatial analysis, image analysis, deep learning, generative AI, and much more.

## About

Life Science Network is an internet platform for professional networking and sharing information and
knowledge in the life sciences. The platform integrates multiple functional modules. The Jobs module
supports researchers in life sciences and their careers, featuring a job board where employers can
publish offers in life sciences and related disciplines. The Protocols module helps share laboratory
research protocols and recipes to improve the reproducibility of scientific work. The Events module
enables the sharing of information about scientific conferences, workshops, seminars, and webinars.
Other modules include the Publications module, Preprints module, Science News module, and more.

In addition, we can support your research by developing custom web applications, data repositories,
tools for data analysis and visualization, and tailored solutions for the communication and
dissemination of your project results. We also develop custom application management systems
tailored to your specific needs. While these may resemble components of the platform, they are
independent solutions without limitations in design or functionality. Whether you're looking to
build a candidate management tool, a recruitment system, or another specialized application, we can
help turn your concept into a standalone web-based solution. [Contact us][101]

## About

Life Science Network is an internet platform for professional networking and sharing information and
knowledge in the life sciences. The platform integrates multiple functional modules. The Jobs module
supports researchers in life sciences and their careers, featuring a job board where employers can
publish offers in life sciences and related disciplines. The Protocols module helps share laboratory
research protocols and recipes to improve the reproducibility of scientific work. The Events module
enables the sharing of information about scientific conferences, workshops, seminars, and webinars.
Other modules include the Publications module, Preprints module, Science News module, and more.

In addition, we can support your research by developing custom web applications, data repositories,
tools for data analysis and visualization, and tailored solutions for the communication and
dissemination of your project results. We also develop custom application management systems
tailored to your specific needs. While these may resemble components of the platform, they are
independent solutions without limitations in design or functionality. Whether you're looking to
build a candidate management tool, a recruitment system, or another specialized application, we can
help turn your concept into a standalone web-based solution. [Contact us][101]

## What we do

We strive to be best in class within the UK acoustic panel design and installation market. We have
significant experience within our project design and management team and look forward to working
with you on your project.



#### Expertise

Our experienced projects team have backgrounds in technical design and engineering allowing us to
make our products fit the precise requirements of your space.


#### Collaboration

We follow our projects from conception to handover, collaborating along the supply chain from
Architect and Interior Designer to Installer and Client.
ࠄ

#### Design

We are proud to work with the most exacting clients, drawing from years of practice creating bespoke
solutions with our suppliers.

ࠅ

#### Manufacture

All our manufacturers make your products specifically to your order to ensure accurate and efficient
installation with minimal material wastage.



#### Installation

We have a dedicated shortlist of recommended installers based across the UK and a growing list of
new contractors with great experience installing our products.
Z

#### Quality

Our carefully curated portfolio of products come with industry leading warranty periods and even
longer expected lifespans with some of our favourite installations dating back 20 years.

### About Navitas Life Sciences

Navitas Life Sciences is a knowledge-driven, CRO offering bespoke solutions for pharma, biotech,
devices and non-profits. We leverage rich insights and cutting-edge technology to ensure compliance,
efficiency and accelerate your products to market.

[Learn more][90]

### Advisory

Fueled by insights from our industry networks, our Advisory Services leverage extensive medical and
regulatory expertise to provide strategic guidance. We offer tailored solutions driven by domain
knowledge to navigate regulations, optimize clinical strategies, and maximize product success.

**300+** Consulting Engagements **|** **100+** Global Clients **|** **90%** Re-engagement **|**
**10** Unique, Proprietary Industry Networks **|** **110+** Network Members

[Image]
[Image]

### Clinical Development

Our Clinical Development services span clinical operations, project management, data sciences, and
medical services. Leveraging cutting-edge technology and domain expertise, we ensure regulatory
compliance and operational efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle, delivering
high-quality data and insights.

**20+** Therapeutic Areas **|** Data Sciences: **150+** Drug Submissions Assisted **|****500+**
Bioanalytical Methods Developed

### Post Marketing

Our Post-Marketing solutions drive sustained product success through safety surveillance, lifecycle
management, real-world evidence generation, and scientific writing services. Ensuring regulatory
compliance and operational efficiency, we deliver a competitive advantage to maximize product value
and market opportunities.

**75,000+** Cases Processed Annually **|** **100+** Global Clients **|** **30+** Years Shaping the

# Most AI pilots stall before production. We build the ones that *ship* — and prove they work.

NewGenApps is a small, senior team that takes AI from first experiment to production. The people who
scope the work build it, evaluate it and verify the live outcome.

[Diagnose your AI pilot][15] [See the proof][16]

The working archive / vol. 18

**NG**Built early.
Still building.

The record begins with what shipped, not what was promised.

The evidence precedes the pitch

We have spent eighteen years turning emerging technology into working systems. The archive is part
of the proof.

2008

2008 — NewGenApps founded as the modern mobile and cloud eras began.

2009

2009 — Early augmented-reality work on the first commercial Android generation.

2011

[
01

### The pilot is stuck

AI Rescue ][18] [
02

You need a ranked opportunity, a real constraint map and a defensible first build.

AI Compass ][19] [
03

### You need to prove value quickly

A working, evaluated proof on your systems and data — designed to become production.

POC in 3 Weeks ][20] [
04

### You need the team that can stay

A small senior pod that moves from build to operation without a handoff cliff.

Embedded AI Team ][21]

03 / Production proof record

## A deployment is not proof. The live outcome is.

Every engagement defines what success means before the build, how the system will be evaluated and
what evidence must exist before production is accepted.

01

**Outcome contract** — The business and system result is explicit.

02

**Evaluation harness** — Reliability is measured against known cases and failure modes.

03

**Data-integrity boundary** — Sources, transformations and prohibited data are traceable.

04

**Live-system verification** — Production behavior is checked after deployment, not inferred from a
merge.

## The people who scope the work stay to prove it.

01

### Diagnose

Find the constraint, the decision and the economic value.

02

### Build

Ship the smallest system that can test the real outcome.

03

### Verify

Evaluate reliability, data integrity and production behavior.

04

### Operate

Improve the system with evidence from live use.

The point of the archive is not nostalgia. It shows a repeatable habit: understand a technology wave
early, then stay for the difficult implementation work.

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Niche finder, and Chrome extension?
[collapse]
Niche Finder: Our Niche Finder helps you discover and track YouTube channels and keywords, providing
insights into growth, strategy, and revenue. Chrome Extension: The Chrome Extension offers advanced
tools for researching videos and channels while automating your workflow, making content creation
more efficient.
Can I buy each product individually?
[expand]
Some products can be purchased individually, like Chrome Extension (Lite package) and the YouTube
Faceless Course. The Niche Finder always comes with the Chrome Extension (Pro package).
What data does NexLev track?
[expand]
NexLev tracks public YouTube data such as channel growth, video performance, keyword rankings, and
engagement metrics. We do not track or store any personal or private channel information.
How does NexLev handle my data?
[expand]
NexLev prioritizes your privacy and data security. We employ industry-standard encryption and
safeguard measures to protect your information. We NEVER share your data with third parties, and it
is only used to improve your experience on our platform. We only collect front end & public data,
like video view counts & subscriber counts.
How accurate are the metrics?
[expand]
NexLev metrics are among the most accurate in the industry, as they are based on real-time data and
advanced algorithms. Our system algorithms continuously update to provide the most reliable insights
into channel growth, video performance, and market trends. Do keep in mind some data is estimated,
as is common in the industry. Since the YouTube API limits us in a number of ways.
Does the Chrome Extension work on Brave & Firefox?
[expand]
Currently, the NexLev Chrome Extension is optimized for Google Chrome. We are working on expanding
support to other browsers, including Brave and Firefox. Stay tuned for updates!
What exactly is NexLev?
[expand]
NexLev is a comprehensive suite of creator tools designed to support every aspect of managing a
faceless YouTube channel. From learning foundational strategies to finding profitable niches,
automating workflows, and managing multiple channels, NexLev equips you with everything you need to
succeed.
How does the pricing work for NexLev?
[expand]
NexLev offers both free and paid tools, with pricing details available on each product's dedicated
page. You can choose between a Lite package (Extension only) or a Pro package (Extension and Niche
Finder) and purchase the YouTube Faceless Course individually.
How long after making a purchase do I have to request a refund?
[expand]
You can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if you're unsatisfied with our product.
Simply email us at contact@nexlev.io with your reason for the request and the purchase email, and we
will process your refund within 72 hours. Please refer to your bank for exact timing on how long it
takes for the funds to be reflected in your bank account.
Does NexLev guarantee success on YouTube?
[expand]
While NexLev provides powerful tools to increase your chances of finding profitable niches and
optimizing channel performance, we cannot guarantee success. Your results depend on various factors
such as content quality, consistency, audience engagement, and overall channel strategy.
Can I buy NexLev for my team?
[expand]
Yes, you can purchase NexLev tools for multiple team members. We offer flexible licensing options to
suit teams of all sizes, making it easier for everyone to access the resources they need to grow
your channel.
What kind of customer support does NexLev offer?
[expand]
NexLev offers comprehensive support through email (contact@nexlev.io). Our support team is dedicated
to resolving any issues you may encounter efficiently.
What is the Nexlev MCP server?
[expand]
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants connect directly to
external data sources. Nexlev's MCP server exposes our full analytics platform — channel data,
revenue estimates, niche intelligence, and more — so AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT can answer
your YouTube research questions using real, live data instead of general knowledge.
Which AI tools work with Nexlev MCP?
[expand]
Any tool that supports the MCP protocol works out of the box — Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor,
Windsurf, and more. If your AI tool supports MCP connections, you can plug Nexlev in and start
querying immediately.
Is Nexlev MCP free to use?
[expand]
Yes, Nexlev MCP is available to all Nexlev account holders at no extra cost. You can connect in
under 30 seconds — no credit card required beyond your existing subscription.

your channel.
What kind of customer support does NexLev offer?
[expand]
NexLev offers comprehensive support through email (contact@nexlev.io). Our support team is dedicated
to resolving any issues you may encounter efficiently.
What is the Nexlev MCP server?
[expand]
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants connect directly to
external data sources. Nexlev's MCP server exposes our full analytics platform — channel data,
revenue estimates, niche intelligence, and more — so AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT can answer
your YouTube research questions using real, live data instead of general knowledge.
Which AI tools work with Nexlev MCP?
[expand]
Any tool that supports the MCP protocol works out of the box — Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor,
Windsurf, and more. If your AI tool supports MCP connections, you can plug Nexlev in and start
querying immediately.
Is Nexlev MCP free to use?
[expand]
Yes, Nexlev MCP is available to all Nexlev account holders at no extra cost. You can connect in
under 30 seconds — no credit card required beyond your existing subscription.

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

Smile. ## Career areas Human Resources & Administration Finance & Legal Research & Development Technology Marketing & Sales Production & Operation Supply Chain [Administration][135] [Health & Safety][136] [Human Resources][137] [Go to HR & Administration][138] [Accounting][139] [Finance][140] [Legal][141] [Procurement][142] [Go to Finance & Legal ][143] [Food & Life Sciences][144] [Product Engineer][145] [Packaging Engineering][146] [Research Analytics][147] [Research & Development][148] [Go to Research & Development][149] [Cybersecurity][150] [Data Science & Analytics][151] [eCommerce][152] [Information Technology][153] [Project & Product Management][154] [Software Engineering][155] [Strategy][156] [Transformation][157] [Go to Technology ][158] [Communications][159] [Design][160] [Marketing][161] [Marketing Analytics][162] [Sales][163] [Go to Marketing & Sales][164] [Maintenance & Security][165] [Operations Safety][166] [Production][167] [Go to Production & Operations][168] [Supply Chain Management][169] [Transportation & Logistics][170] [Warehouse Positions][171] [Go to Supply Chain ][172] ### Grow with pepsico Looking for internships and early career opportunities? PepsiCo is fun, dynamic and a place where you can build your skills and advance without changing who you are. We value your unique stories, skill sets and fresh perspectives. #### Join pepsico as a new grad From engineering to law, PepsiCo invites new grads to help define the future of our iconic brands and your career. [Search jobs ][173] #### Internships & programs On the way to your bachelor’s or MBA, work experience with PepsiCo is exciting and transformative. [Learn more ][174] #### Find pepsiCo Events near you Let’s meet up! In-person and virtual recruiting events happen around the world throughout the year. [Search events ][175] Our culture ### More than just a food and beverage company We dare to make the world smile and to put each other first. [Learn more][176] Innovation ### Work with some of the world’s most iconic brands PepsiCo’s range of thousands – yes, thousands! — of foods and beverages make consumers smile all around the globe. When you work at PepsiCo, you’re on a team daring to take these brands to the next level. [Learn more about our brands][177] ### PURPOSE-DRIVEN AGRICULTURE PepsiCo associates are helping shape what’s next in agriculture — working with farmers, strengthening supply chains, and advancing pep+. The story behind your next Lay’s, Doritos, or Quaker bite may start with them. [Read more][178] From farm to future, we’re growing more smiles—for people, communities, and the planet. [Read more][179] ### SHAPING FOOD & DRINK MOMENTS From creating global culinary content to driving digital innovation, PepsiCo associates are helping define how our iconic brands connect with consumers through food and beverages. [Learn more][180] Turning creativity and digital innovation into moments that make people smile. [Learn more][181] ### CULTURE THAT POWERS CAREERS Inclusion, trust, and ownership come to life at PepsiCo—empowering our associates to grow, lead, and make an impact. [Find out more][182] Our inclusive culture empowers our associates to act as owners. [Find out more][183] ### CELEBRATING EXCELLENCE From the case to the shelf, PepsiCo associates bring strategy to life, delivering excellence that reaches consumers across markets. [Read more][184] We raise the bar every day through impact, leadership, and how we show up for others. [Read more][185] ### Sign up for smiles Join the PepsiCo Talent Community. One simple sign-up shares your profile with PepsiCo recruiters, who may consider you for future opportunities that match your skills. [Join Today][186] ### What the industry says about working at pepsico #### We never stop improving We’re proud of the recognition we’ve received as an employer, a community partner and a corporation committed to global sustainability. But we never let an award or a great review stop us from looking for ways we can be a better employer, a stronger company and a better global change-maker. [Get to know our culture][187] #### PepsiCo Ratings on Glassdoor ##### Overall review 4.0 [Ramon

Smile. ## Career areas Human Resources & Administration Finance & Legal Research & Development Technology Marketing & Sales Production & Operation Supply Chain [Administration][135] [Health & Safety][136] [Human Resources][137] [Go to HR & Administration][138] [Accounting][139] [Finance][140] [Legal][141] [Procurement][142] [Go to Finance & Legal ][143] [Food & Life Sciences][144] [Product Engineer][145] [Packaging Engineering][146] [Research Analytics][147] [Research & Development][148] [Go to Research & Development][149] [Cybersecurity][150] [Data Science & Analytics][151] [eCommerce][152] [Information Technology][153] [Project & Product Management][154] [Software Engineering][155] [Strategy][156] [Transformation][157] [Go to Technology ][158] [Communications][159] [Design][160] [Marketing][161] [Marketing Analytics][162] [Sales][163] [Go to Marketing & Sales][164] [Maintenance & Security][165] [Operations Safety][166] [Production][167] [Go to Production & Operations][168] [Supply Chain Management][169] [Transportation & Logistics][170] [Warehouse Positions][171] [Go to Supply Chain ][172] ### Grow with pepsico Looking for internships and early career opportunities? PepsiCo is fun, dynamic and a place where you can build your skills and advance without changing who you are. We value your unique stories, skill sets and fresh perspectives. #### Join pepsico as a new grad From engineering to law, PepsiCo invites new grads to help define the future of our iconic brands and your career. [Search jobs ][173] #### Internships & programs On the way to your bachelor’s or MBA, work experience with PepsiCo is exciting and transformative. [Learn more ][174] #### Find pepsiCo Events near you Let’s meet up! In-person and virtual recruiting events happen around the world throughout the year. [Search events ][175] Our culture ### More than just a food and beverage company We dare to make the world smile and to put each other first. [Learn more][176] Innovation ### Work with some of the world’s most iconic brands PepsiCo’s range of thousands – yes, thousands! — of foods and beverages make consumers smile all around the globe. When you work at PepsiCo, you’re on a team daring to take these brands to the next level. [Learn more about our brands][177] ### PURPOSE-DRIVEN AGRICULTURE PepsiCo associates are helping shape what’s next in agriculture — working with farmers, strengthening supply chains, and advancing pep+. The story behind your next Lay’s, Doritos, or Quaker bite may start with them. [Read more][178] From farm to future, we’re growing more smiles—for people, communities, and the planet. [Read more][179] ### SHAPING FOOD & DRINK MOMENTS From creating global culinary content to driving digital innovation, PepsiCo associates are helping define how our iconic brands connect with consumers through food and beverages. [Learn more][180] Turning creativity and digital innovation into moments that make people smile. [Learn more][181] ### CULTURE THAT POWERS CAREERS Inclusion, trust, and ownership come to life at PepsiCo—empowering our associates to grow, lead, and make an impact. [Find out more][182] Our inclusive culture empowers our associates to act as owners. [Find out more][183] ### CELEBRATING EXCELLENCE From the case to the shelf, PepsiCo associates bring strategy to life, delivering excellence that reaches consumers across markets. [Read more][184] We raise the bar every day through impact, leadership, and how we show up for others. [Read more][185] ### Sign up for smiles Join the PepsiCo Talent Community. One simple sign-up shares your profile with PepsiCo recruiters, who may consider you for future opportunities that match your skills. [Join Today][186] ### What the industry says about working at pepsico #### We never stop improving We’re proud of the recognition we’ve received as an employer, a community partner and a corporation committed to global sustainability. But we never let an award or a great review stop us from looking for ways we can be a better employer, a stronger company and a better global change-maker. [Get to know our culture][187] #### PepsiCo Ratings on Glassdoor ##### Overall review 4.0 [Ramon

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

## Let’s connect

Ready to transform your work with data storytelling? Connect with our team to learn more and get

[Get in touch][41]
What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

implied enterprise value of $585 million. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of

locked token sale to strategic investors. Pantera Capital led the first close, with participation
from Bain Capital Crypto, Eightco Holdings, Selini Capital, Susquehanna Crypto, and other investors.

[

][18] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:53 PM
AegisAI, an email security company building its own large language models to defend the inbox,
announced a $36 million Series A led by Battery Ventures, with participation from existing investors
Accel and Foundation Capital. The round brings the company's total funding to $49 million, less than
a year after emerging from stealth. AegisAI will use the funding to scale its fleet of autonomous
defense agents, accelerate general availability of Vanguard, its agent that hunts threats beyond the
inbox, and expand enterprise go-to-market efforts.
[

### Paper Raises $34 Million Series A To Build Design Platform For The Agentic Era

][19] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:51 PM

Series A round led by Accel and ICONIQ. Additional participants include Designer Fund, WorkOS
co-founder Michael Grinich, Lovable founder Anton Osika, and individual engineers and designers from
Anthropic and OpenAI. The company plans to use the funding to accelerate product development, expand
its team, and deepen investment in AI-native workflows for designers.
[

A group of investors including Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund has secured EU antitrust
approval for its $55 billion acquisition of video game developer Electronic Arts, the European
Commission announced. Saudi Arabia's $1 trillion wealth fund, alongside Jared Kushner's Affinity
Partners and private equity firm Silver Lake, first announced the deal, described as the largest

## Possible isn’t enough,

## it has to be easy.

In a reality of ever-growing analytics needs, Pyramid prevents the exponential growth in complexity.
Possible isn't enough, it has to be easy for data teams and business users to keep up with the pace
of the modern business

[PLATFORM OVERVIEW][106]
[Data prep & science]
[Data prep & science]

## Data prep & science

Pyramid includes hundreds of built-in data connectors, and a super-fast direct query engine that
ensures flexibility and high performance without data extractions. From data wrangling to advanced
machine learning models, Pyramid enables sophistication without complexity.

[Semantics & logic]
[Semantics & logic]

## Semantics & logic

Virtual semantic models hide database complexities while enhancing the analytical experience for
querying and analysis. Sophisticated, complex functions and hierarchies can be easily built. Define
and share custom formulas, business logic, and dynamic calculations.

[Business analytics ]
[Business analytics ]

## Business analytics

Pyramid streamlines data discovery by enabling users to interactively query and analyze data
directly from live sources using AI, drag and drop, or a spreadsheet-like interface. Create
interactive visualizations using customized charts, infographics, and real-time dashboards. Enrich
your analysis further with contextual commentary, dynamic slicers, external content, images, and
interactive data-driven components.

[Collaborate & distribute ]
[Collaborate & distribute ]

## Collaborate & distribute

Transform reports and dashboards into collaborative workspaces with built-in annotations, real-time
commenting, tagging, and data snapshots, to help teams maintain context and streamline
decision-making. Robust reporting capabilities support both dynamic embedded dashboards and
customized, pixel-perfect static reports that can be scheduled or exported as multiple formats.

[Fully governed & secure ]
[Fully governed & secure ]

## Fully governed & secure

Pyramid provides robust governance and enterprise-grade security, offering granular, role-based
access control. Features like Tabulate, Master Flow, and a centralized business logic library ensure
data consistency, version control, and standardized metrics, while built-in auditing and usage
monitoring support compliance and informed resource management.

## Advanced analytics on an enterprise scale with zero complexity

Pyramid’s all-in-one platform for intelligent analytics drives smarter, faster data-backed decisions
at every level of your organization
* ### Deploy
  
  On a private cloud, on-premises, in a hybrid environment, or hosted and managed by us, Pyramid’s
  platform can be deployed anywhere.
  
  [Learn More][107]
* ### Connect
  
  Pyramid works directly on top of your existing data infrastructure. It comes with over 250
  built-in connectors and PYRANA, a super-fast direct query engine. No more downloading, moving, or
  copying your data.
  
  [Learn More][108]
* ### Prepare
  
  With blend, join, and column operations, data science, machine learning, heuristics, and semantic
  layers, Pyramid’s data prep environment enables sophistication without complexity.
  
  [Learn More][109]
* ### Analyze
  
  Advanced reporting with robust data discovery capabilities, including one-click forecasting,
  AI-generated insights, and automated root cause analysis.
  
  [Learn More][110]
* ### Distribute
  
  Embed dashboards and reports directly into your application or website. Export reports as PDF,
  Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JSON, or image files. Share reports directly with stakeholders via email
  using advanced scheduling options.
  
  [Learn More][111]
* ### Collaborate
  
  Start a conversation with other users on a specific data point or snapshot using annotations,
  tags, and comments. 
  
  [Learn More][112]
* ### Govern
  
  Universally control data, content, and feature access permissions on a granular level.
  
  [Learn More][113]

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

For more FAQs and Help, visit our [Help Center.][72]

### SERVICES

#### RIGHT PATIENT. RIGHT CARE SETTING. EVERY TIME.

# Move patients forward

Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform built for policy-grade decisioning and patient
flow at scale. Tennr helps providers navigate patients through complex payer requirements, countless
engagements, and every step in between.

[Learn More][9]

#### AT A GLANCE

## With Tennr, patients flow

Make intelligent operational decisions through every patient order, referral, or complex care
journey. Made possible by proprietary models trained on the largest dataset of service-to-payer
criteria mappings.

#### THE BOTTOM LINE

## No delays. Fewer denials. Optimal patient journeys.

Tennr intelligently processes and routes patients so high-performing healthcare operations can route
to the right care, in the right setting, every time.

### Move patients to the right places

Eliminate the operational friction that slows progression between consults, diagnostics,
authorizations, and scheduling.

### Slash first-pass denials

Turn a library of payer criteria into automatic operational decisions. Assemble proof, prioritize
care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

### Close the loop in care coordination

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.

[Explore the Product][10]

#### WHO WE WORK WITH

## Trusted nationwide

From national networks to independent providers, we power operations and millions of care pathways
each month.

#### KEEP PATIENTS MOVING

## Patient flow, optimized

Tennr keeps your patients moving through their care journeys without creating work for your team,
creating clarity and improving your cash flows at the same time.

Tennr automatically classifies and routes patient data from any source—fax, portal, internal
order—into the right operational workflows.

Wherever charts and orders need to reflect changes, they'll be automatically updated.

Tennr can check eligibility, investigate benefits over the phone, and submit prior authorizations.

Your patients' authorization status and medical necessity criteria will directly drive Tennr's
recommendations.

Finally, Tennr uses all of the data it touches to intelligently drive patient routing decisions,
unblock what’s stuck, and get you paid faster.

#### Testimonials

## What our customers say

They're improving quality, moving faster, and freeing up their teams. Here's what they have to say:

“With Tennr, we’re able to do things so much faster, and it's just huge. It’s been a game changer.
We’re able to reach out to patients so much faster.”

[Alyssa Jakubowski - Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical]

Alyssa Jakubowski
Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical

# Execution, Where it Matters Most
#  

SciLnq supports development-stage sponsors through embedded regulatory, product development,
technical, clinical, and operational expertise.

[Schedule a Conversation][22]

## When Execution Slows, Everything Is at Risk

In emerging biotech and medical device companies, delays in regulatory strategy, product
development, technical execution, or clinical progression can quickly impact timelines, operational
momentum, and broader organizational objectives.


SciLnq partners with development-stage sponsors during these critical stages, embedding experienced
professionals who provide expertise, execution continuity, and forward momentum where it is needed
most.


We focus on the areas that directly influence development progression, helping organizations move
with greater clarity, continuity, and confidence.

[Learn More About SciLnq][23]
[teammates]

### How We Engage

Embedded Consultants & Functional Teams

We integrate experienced consultants and cross-fucntional teams directly within your organization,
aligned to your priorities, accountable to outcomes, and focused on execution.

### Clarity at Critical Stages

Immediate Meaningful Contribution

We step in when timelines tighten, expertise gaps emerge, or internal bandwidth is stretched,
providing experienced execution where it's needed most.

### Senior Industry Expertise

Experienced Scientific & Operational Leaders

Our consultants and functional teams bring deep experience across scientific, regulatory, clinical,
technical, and operational disciplines, integrating quickly to provide experienced execution without
the onboarding and ramp-up time of a traditional hire.

## Where SciLnq Adds Value

Not every challenge requires a full-time hire.

SciLnq is typically engaged when execution gaps begin to impact progress, whether in regulatory
strategy, product development, or clinical readiness.


Our model is designed to integrate quickly, reduce complexity, and deliver experienced leadership
without the burden of long-term hiring.


We provide experienced expertise where execution is at risk and programs require additional support.

Science that benefits people

Our aim is to enrich personal health through scientific tools and solutions.

About Trajan Scientific and Medical

In July 2011 the idea of Trajan was born, to create an enterprise to translate analytical science in
tangible ways to directly benefit society.

[Our story][92]

What we do, is about you

##### Scientific measurement is important to human wellbeing

We live in a world where the opportunity to better understand our personal health and wellbeing is
changing. Where and how we live, what we consume, and how our biology responds determines our
wellbeing. Increasingly, scientific measurement allows us to develop our understanding of those
factors.

## Analytical

Trajan is a global provider of engineered components and analytical technologies with a strong
background in chromatography and mass spectrometry. These technologies enable measurements in
biology, food and the environment.

We are a key partner in producing critical components and materials for analytical workflow and
measurement. Our aim is to design and deliver a portfolio of analytical tools to enable best
practice laboratory performance, enhancing confidence in result quality.

[Learn more][93]

Trajan's life science solutions span the development of medical devices for microsample collection,
premium pathology products, precision components for mass spectrometry, and automated workflow
solutions.

We enhance and optimize workflows with a variety of automated preparative or sample collection
systems ready to integrate into laboratories, or generate custom solutions for life science research
and development.

Science that benefits people

Our aim is to enrich personal health through scientific tools and solutions.

About Trajan Scientific and Medical

In July 2011 the idea of Trajan was born, to create an enterprise to translate analytical science in
tangible ways to directly benefit society.

[Our story][92]

What we do, is about you

##### Scientific measurement is important to human wellbeing

We live in a world where the opportunity to better understand our personal health and wellbeing is
changing. Where and how we live, what we consume, and how our biology responds determines our
wellbeing. Increasingly, scientific measurement allows us to develop our understanding of those
factors.

## Analytical

Trajan is a global provider of engineered components and analytical technologies with a strong
background in chromatography and mass spectrometry. These technologies enable measurements in
biology, food and the environment.

We are a key partner in producing critical components and materials for analytical workflow and
measurement. Our aim is to design and deliver a portfolio of analytical tools to enable best
practice laboratory performance, enhancing confidence in result quality.

[Learn more][93]

## Life sciences

Trajan's life science solutions span the development of medical devices for microsample collection,
premium pathology products, precision components for mass spectrometry, and automated workflow
solutions.

We enhance and optimize workflows with a variety of automated preparative or sample collection
systems ready to integrate into laboratories, or generate custom solutions for life science research
and development.

[Learn more][94]
